It repairs the largest measured failure region with paired curves for pyridines, quinolines, amino-nitriles, acids, and phosphorus-containing graphs. It samples oxygenated carbonyl and alcohol families at intermediate PE/EA and loading values to improve V1/V2 endpoint interactions, especially the recurring V2 tails. It also includes a smaller set of sulfur, sulfone, fused, and nitro-benzophenone rows where local graph coverage is sparse. Repeated same-molecule points are deliberate: they discriminate condition slope, loading effects, and nonmonotonic behavior, while the rare-graph anchors extend those learned relationships to uncovered parts of the Row-distribution. The batch is intended to improve structure-condition-retention transfer and endpoint calibration after retraining."}
